This document outlines the 
major maintenance procedures 
P1، والذي يجب إجراؤه كل خمس سنوات كما هو مشار إليه في Y5 
في كتلة العنوان.

Technical specification 
of Steam Turbine:
Nominal Output at Steam Quantity Rate 670 t/h

At Oil Combustion 
 206 MW

At Gas combustion 
 210 MW

Nominal Turbine Speed 
 3000 rpm

Nominal Steam Pressure 
 16.42 Mpa

Nominal Steam Temperature 530 
C
Nominal Reheating Steam Pressure 4 Mpa
Nominal Temperature of Cooling Water 27 C

Critical Speed of HP Rotor 
 2400

Safety Precaution
يجب إصدار تصريح العمل.

The qualified maintenance staff should be trained and carry the 
 suitable safety ID category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required

Wear the safety and healthy 
equipment as safety helmet, shoes, gloves
 etc.
Shutdown the unit.
Generator should be isolated.
Isolate the circuit breaker of generator
Disconnect the electric terminals of generator

The oil of turbine must be isolated mechanically by closing delivery and 
 suction valves.
Be sure turbine must be completely drainage

sections.text: External Inspection of the Dismounted HP Turbine Parts

All control cones of HP control valves No. 1 till 4 are damaged by impurities 
 contemned HP steam and we had changed complete drw. TP 216917 .

HP nozzle segment 1 blade missing , all blades Deformed , nozzle segment is 
 complete damage .

HP rotor moving wheel 1a 4a are with out seal knifes on enter side of 
 steam. Moving wheels A , 1a , 2a , 3a , - the blades are damaged by big 
 foreign pieces in steam .

After sand blasting of HP rotor we made curry out the capilar test on blades 
 moving wheels A , 1a , 2a , 3a and some diaphragm wheels.

Rotors check whether bearing pins and plates are not damaged. Check whether 
 blades of moving wheels are not bent, split or injured by foreign bodies or 
 cracks.

Turbine casings check whether parting plane is not deformed and damaged. 
 Check possible cracks of turbine casings.
Guide wheels check whether guide blades are not bent, split, or broken.

Radial and axial bearings check whether antifriction metal is not worn out, 
 released or broken.

Labyrinth rings check whether edges are not worn out or split in the seal 
 bodies and in guide wheels. The strips should not be cut off by labyrinth 
 rings in a rotor.

Next inspection e.g. of control bodies will be carried out in the course of 
 dismounting and repair.
